topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture and outlines the focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Principles of innate immune recognition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish how the innate immune system detects microbial products and tissue damage using molecular patterns while distinguishing self from non-self.

topics.label: Pattern recognition receptor pathways and inflammasome activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail specific PRR receptor families, their subcellular signaling cascades, and the multi-protein inflammasome activation pathway.

topics.label: Inflammatory execution, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic effects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sentinel cell activation directs leukocyte recruitment, lymphatic drainage, and the systemic consequences of excessive inflammation.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the mechanisms that terminate acute inflammation, mediate tissue repair, and govern persistent or structural chronic inflammatory states.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic wraps up the lecture and previews the next lecture topic.
